snippet.title: Edgar Allan Poe's Interactive Horror: 1995 Edition - Official Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
GMedia is proud to announce that the Steam store page for Edgar Allan Poe's Interactive Horror: 1995 Edition is now live. Originally released as The Dark Eye, this faithful restoration brings the avant-garde nightmare of the CD-ROM era to modern PCs.

Experience the twisted tales of Edgar Allan Poe through a surreal collage of stop-motion puppetry and distorted video, featuring the haunting narration of Beat Generation icon William S. Burroughs and an original score by Thomas Dolby.
